mapper.select: select a.cm_jobcd, b.cm_jobname , nvl(b.cm_deptcd,a.cm_jobcd) cm_deptcd from cmm0034 a, cmm0102 b where a.cm_syscd=#{id} and a.CM_CLOSEDT is null and a.cm_jobcd = b.cm_jobcd order by b.cm_jobname, a.cm_jobcd

select a.cm_jobcd, b.cm_jobname , nvl(b.cm_deptcd,a.cm_jobcd) cm_deptcd from cmm0044 a, cmm0102 b where a.cm_syscd=#{CM_SYSCD} and a.cm_userid=#{CM_USERID} and a.CM_CLOSEDT is null and a.cm_jobcd = b.cm_jobcd order by b.cm_jobname, a.cm_jobcd
select a.cm_jobcd from cmm0034 a,cmm0044 b where a.cm_syscd=#{syscd} and a.cm_syscd=b.cm_syscd and a.cm_closedt is null and b.cm_userid=#{userid} and rownum=1
